items.claim: Prov.31.1-9 is one royal-instruction unit opened by the divrei-plus-massa Lemuel header and sustained by the mother's vocative address through 31:8, closed by the petuchah at 31:9, with the 31:2 bar-vocatives correctly framed as Aramaic-influence discussion rather than a verse-language label.

PE at Prov.31.9 matches pmarks_Prov.json and is confirmed the chapter's only PE mark.
